teaser.en: The soap plant: its fruits were a homemade substitute for detergent.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa sabuni: matunda yake yalikuwa mbadala wa sabuni uliotengenezwa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa sabuni: matundage kala ganahumirwa dza sabuni ya kaya badala ya sabuni ya kugula.

summary.en: Msabuni is a Jatropha, a soft-stemmed plant whose fruits the Digo use in place of soap. Its name simply means 'soap'.
summary.sw: Msabuni ni mmea wa jenasi Jatropha, wenye shina laini, ambao matunda yake Wadigo huyatumia badala ya sabuni. Jina lake lina maana ya 'sabuni' tu.
summary.dg: Msabuni ni aina ya Jatropha, mmea wenye kolo laini ambao matundage Adigo anagahumira badala ya sabuni. Dzinare rina mana ya 'sabuni' tu.

about.en: Pakia identified Msabuni only to genus, as a species of Jatropha, and the Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant. Jatrophas are soft-wooded shrubs or herbs with milky or watery sap, lobed leaves and small, often greenish or red flowers, followed by three-sided capsules holding oily seeds.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Msabuni hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kama spishi ya Jatropha, na Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima. Mimea ya Jatropha ni vichaka au mimea ya mbao laini yenye utomvu wa maziwa au wa majimaji, majani yenye pindo, na maua madogo ambayo mara nyingi ni ya kijani au mekundu, yakifuatwa na vifuko vyenye pande tatu vilivyo na mbegu zenye mafuta.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Msabuni hadi jenasi tu, dza aina ya Jatropha, na Adigo anaumanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi. Mimea ya Jatropha ni vitsaka au mimea midide yenye nyama za muhi laini, yenye utomvu dza maziya au dza madzi, makodza ganayoganyika kpwa seemu, na maruwa madide, mara nyinji ga chijani ngushu-ngushu au ga kundu; maruwa gachimala kunamera matunda makavu ga pembe tahu ganayokala na tembe zenye mafuha.

where.en: Pakia does not say where it was collected. Jatrophas on the coast grow in dry bushland, on farm edges and as hedges around homesteads.
where.sw: Pakia haelezi ulikusanywa wapi. Pwani, mimea ya Jatropha huota katika vichaka vikavu, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kama ua kuzunguka makazi.
where.dg: Pakia kagomba ni kuphi ambako mmea hinyu wahalwa. Pwani, Jatropha inamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, kanda-kanda ya minda na dza lichigo kuzunguluka midzi.

uses.en: The fruits are used as an alternative to detergent, for washing. Jatropha seeds and sap are poisonous if eaten, so the plant is a washing aid, not a food.
uses.sw: Matunda yake hutumika kama mbadala wa sabuni kwa kufulia na kuoshea. Mbegu na utomvu wa Jatropha ni sumu vikiliwa, kwa hiyo mmea huu ni msaada wa kuoshea, si chakula.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuhumirwa badala ya sabuni, kpwa kusuwa vitu. Tembe na utomvu wa Jatropha vina sumu mutu achivirya, kpwa hivyo mmea uhu ni wa kusuwira, si wa kurya.

culture.en: Pakia lists Msabuni among Digo names that describe a plant's product: the plant is named after the thing it is used to make, like Msuwaki (toothbrush) and Msusu (bird trap).
culture.sw: Pakia anauorodhesha Msabuni miongoni mwa majina ya Kidigo yanayoeleza zao la mmea: mmea hupewa jina la kitu kinachotengenezwa kwa kuutumia, kama Msuwaki (mswaki) na Msusu (mtego wa ndege).
culture.dg: Pakia anauika Msabuni kahi ya madzina ga Chidigo ganayoonyesa chitu chinacholavywa ni mmea: mmea unaihwa kpwa dzina ra chitu unachohumirwa kuhenda, dza Msuwaki (msuwaki) na Msusu (muhambo wa ndege).

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Msabuni, meaning 'soap' (sabuni), shared with Duruma. The scientific name is Jatropha sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Msabuni, lenye maana ya 'sabuni', linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Jina la kisayansi ni Jatropha sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Msabuni, rina mana ya 'sabuni' (sabuni), na Aduruma nao anarihumira. Dzina ra chisayansi ni Jatropha sp.; aina hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa familia ya mibono wenye mbegu za mafuta na sumu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa jamii mwenga, wenye tembe za mafuha na sumu

reason.en: Also named after the household item it makes
reason.sw: Nao pia umepewa jina la kifaa cha nyumbani unachotengeneza
reason.dg: Nao unaihwa kpwa chitu cha kaya unachohumirwa kuhenda

reason.en: Another plant used like soap elsewhere
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika kama sabuni kwingineko
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaohumirwa dza sabuni phatu phanjina
